introHtml: American Apparel sweatshirts are known for their soft, tri-blend fabric and modern fit, making them a favorite for corporate apparel programs. When you choose custom American Apparel sweatshirts, you get a comfortable garment that employees actually want to wear, whether for a company retreat or a casual Friday uniform. The Triblend Short-Sleeve Track T-Shirt is a popular option for warmer months, while long-sleeve styles work year-round. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished look.
